name: Green coffee bean
summary: Green coffee bean extract (chlorogenic acid) has weight-loss meta-analyses that are positive but industry-tainted, following the Dr. Oz-era hype cycle. Post-hype trial evidence is modest.
description: Canonical Green coffee bean research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until trial-specific efficacy, formulation, dose, longer-term safety, and outcome-boundary evidence has passed the site's review gates.
